edit.text:
This image is a template for 7 parallax backdrop layers of DAWNHARBOR, a white-walled port town at sunrise, in my game's style: soft painted pixel art, warm gold light, plum-violet shade. Replace each WHITE strip with the layer named on it, filling that strip edge to edge and staying inside it: nothing may cross a strip's top or bottom edge, so make each layer only as tall as its strip. The 6 MAGENTA rows between the strips are gaps: leave them untouched, flat magenta #FF00FF, with nothing painted on them, not even sky.
1. FAR LAYER: sky from navy #1d2f5c at the top through blue #3f6aa0 and peach #f2a98a to cream #ffe0b0, over the open sea with a distant line of hazy blue islands. Fills its strip; seamless left to right.
2. MID LAYER: rooftops of the port, white walls and blue tiles stepping up a hill, on magenta (no sky behind them). Seamless left to right.
3. NEAR LAYER: the harbour front, ship masts, rigging and furled sails, on magenta (no sky behind them). Seamless left to right.
4. CLOUDS: 4 separate soft morning clouds, cream with peach undersides, on magenta.
5. LANDMARK: a tall white lighthouse on a rocky point with a sun-shaped lamp, on magenta.
6. SKY BODY: a low warm morning sun with a soft glow ring, on magenta.
7. MOTES: a scatter of sparkles like sun on water and a few distant gulls, on magenta.
Remove the white and the label text: in strips 2 to 7 everything that is not part of the layer becomes flat magenta #FF00FF.

4. CLOUDS: exactly 4 separate soft dusk clouds, one centred in each quarter of the strip, on flat magenta. Remove the castle, the village, the hill and the bridge from this strip.
5. LANDMARK: only the clock tower with its trees, on flat magenta. Remove the pink clouds behind it.
6. SKY BODY: only the round orange moon, on flat magenta, with no clouds and no pink glow around it.
7. MOTES: keep the lanterns and fireflies, on flat magenta, with no pink glow patches.

Cells 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 each hold one flat bright green (#00FF00) shape: the exact outline of the boy in the same cell of the first attached picture, in the same pose (cell 1: winding up a big overhead sword chop, sword fist raised behind his head; cell 2: striking, sword arm stretched straight out in front; cell 3: following through, bent forward with the sword arm swept low; cell 4: knocked back by a hit, leaning back with one arm thrown up; cell 7: sitting on the ground with both legs stretched straight out in front, toes up, hands flat on the ground beside his hips). The second attached picture shows this exact piece already painted on the same boy: copy its colours, materials, shape and details exactly, never its poses. On each green shape, paint ONLY a young archer's laced leather vest worn over his torso and upper arms: a tan brown leather vest laced up the front with a thin cord, over a cream linen shirt with short sleeves over the upper arms, a brown leather strap running from one shoulder across his chest, and a narrow brown belt with a small horn buckle at the waist; the hem is just below the belt. Check every cell for holes before finishing. Leave every part of each green shape you do not paint over flat pure #00FF00 green, exactly as it is, and leave the rest of the background flat pure magenta #FF00FF. Do not move, resize or redraw any shape, and do not add any figure. Leave empty cells empty. Style: warm colours, light from the upper left, smooth soft painted shading with bright highlights, thin dark plum-brown outline, small busy painted detail, like the painted villagers in the third attached picture. Keep the grid lines. No text, no labels.

edit.text: The base picture is an EMPTY sheet of 8 cells (2 rows of 4) on a flat magenta background. Paint the game's base character, a chibi boy, once in each cell listed below, in the pose given for that cell. The first attached picture shows this exact boy in several poses: copy his look exactly (same head, ears, blank face with no eyes, brows or mouth, bald, cream short-sleeved undershirt, brown shorts, barefoot, rounded MITTEN fists with no separate fingers, NO open hands, same size as the boys there, same clean smooth painted style and thin dark plum-brown outline) but NOT his poses. Each new pose must be clearly different from the poses in the first attached picture. He faces right in a slight three-quarter side view. His WEAPON ARM is the arm on the LEFT side of the picture; its fist is a closed mitten fist seen from the side with the thumb on top, so a weapon held in it would lie flat in the picture, never pointing at the viewer; the whole fist and forearm are clearly visible, never hidden behind his head or body. Standing poses have their feet on a common ground line near the bottom of the cell, like the boys in the first attached picture; mid-air poses float clearly above that line. Do NOT draw any weapon, bow, wand, chain, anchor or other object. Cell 1, RISING CUT wind-up: crouched low, knees deeply bent, weapon fist held low behind his back hip. Cell 2, RISING CUT finish: springing up onto his toes, body stretched tall, weapon arm flung straight up overhead, fist high above his head, the other arm swung down and back. Cell 3, GRAVITY PULL gather: feet apart, both arms raised high above his head with both fists up, leaning back slightly. Cell 4, GRAVITY PULL slam: dropped into a low squat, both fists slammed down to the ground in front of his feet. Cell 5, DASH STAB: body low and leaning far forward in a long dash, weapon fist thrust straight out low in front at waist height, the other arm swept back. Cell 6, BACKHAND SLASH: torso twisted round, weapon arm swept across his chest and out behind him on the left at shoulder height, the other fist at his hip. Cell 7, THROW: front foot stepping forward, weapon arm flung forward and up as if hurling something heavy, fist high in front of him, the other arm back. Cell 8, HAUL: leaning far back, heels dug in, front leg straight, both fists pulled in close to his chest one in front of the other, as if hauling a heavy rope toward him. Paint every figure WHOLE, with no gaps, notches or holes, and one figure per listed cell only. Keep the background flat pure magenta #FF00FF and keep the grid lines. Nothing else in the cells: no weapons, props, shadows, motion lines, effects or text. Light from the upper left.
